role: Defines the theatre every other component is scoped to.
decision: Use mecca_urban ((39.45, 21.25, 39.78, 21.58)) as the primary theatre, working in EPSG:32637 metres.
rationale: Rugged Hijaz foothills -- steep, broken granite ridges a few hundred metres high cut by dry wadis -- around the outer western and south-western urban districts. A third terrain morphology beside tehran_basin's single high wall and owens_valley's two parallel ranges: many short ridges in every direction, so masking comes from local relief close to the aircraft rather than from one dominant massif. Outside 3DEP coverage, so the DEM is Copernicus GLO-30. The threat field over this AOI is randomly spawned and parameterised exactly as it is everywhere else in the project; nothing here models any real air-defence disposition, and the guardrail in docs/DATA.md applies unchanged. The AOI was accepted only after the true line-of-sight test confirmed a monotonic masking gradient with height above ground; a flat theatre would make the signature mechanic unlearnable no matter how good the policy is.

parameters.name: mecca_urban
parameters.bounds_policy: A modest rectangular outer-urban and surrounding-relief envelope, about 34 x 36 km, placed entirely WEST of the historic centre. The east edge (39.78 E) is set so the Masjid al-Haram complex and its immediate precinct lie outside the AOI by more than 3 km: nothing in the simulation can be placed there, no terrain or visual data is extracted there, and no camera or effect can use it. The pilgrimage venues to the east (Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat) and Jabal al-Nour lie further outside still. Every place of religious significance near the box is also a protected zone, excluded from visual-data extraction, camera framing, presentation effects and imagery/provider rendering. No religious site, pilgrimage venue, hospital, school or other sensitive civilian location is used as a start point, waypoint, camera focus or backdrop; waypoints are anonymous coordinates drawn by the theatre generator. Bounds are fixed here and recorded in the env.aoi component; changing them changes the AOI fingerprint.

protected_zones.name: Masjid al-Haram complex and immediate precinct
protected_zones.reason: Excluded out of respect for its religious importance. Outside the AOI by construction; also never extracted, framed, used as a backdrop, drawn under provider tiles or imagery, or used for any effect.

protected_zones.name: Masjid Aisha (Tan'eem)
protected_zones.reason: Place of religious significance just east of the box edge; same rule.

protected_zones.name: Jabal al-Nour
protected_zones.reason: Place of religious significance east of the box; same rule.

protected_zones.name: pilgrimage venues (Mina, Muzdalifah, Arafat)
protected_zones.reason: Pilgrimage venues east of the box; never extracted, framed, rendered under provider tiles, or used for any effect.

invariants: Cache keys embed the AOI bounds fingerprint; changing the box invalidates the DEM.
All env geometry is metric UTM; no per-step geodesy.

sources.name: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP)
sources.citation: U.S. Geological Survey, 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) 1/3 arc-second Digital Elevation Model. USGS National Map 3DEP Dynamic Service.
sources.notes: CONUS coverage only. Non-US areas of interest must fall back to Copernicus GLO-30.
